_comment: OpenClaw model config for newton-claw on Jetson Thor. OpenClaw runs OPEN local models via Ollama, unsandboxed on the host. Merge this 'models'/'agents' block into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. Pull the model first:  ollama pull gemma4:12b . Thor's 128 GB unified memory is shared between the sim, training and the LLM — the 12B model (~9 GB) leaves the most room for 4096-env training.
